main.description: Teshuvah / rehabilitation declaration. The Non-Aligned entity retracts the doctrinal position + provides remediation evidence; Council Lv6+ ≥3 sign-off restores enforcement gates. Per ADR-2605192230 §7. Status remains permanent (Rehabilitated value, not Aligned).

originalAttestationUri.description: AT URI of the non-alignment attestation being rehabilitated from.

teshuvahNarrative.description: Self-declared doctrinal retraction + concrete remediation. The 'why I am no longer Non-Aligned' narrative. Public + permanent record.

remediationEvidence.description: URIs of concrete remediation evidence (e.g., divestment announcements, ad business closure, doctrine retraction press release).

councilSigners.description: DIDs of Council Lv6+ members recognizing the teshuvah.

subjectSignature.description: DID-bound signature by the rehabilitating entity over the teshuvahNarrative.

registryTxHash.description: ChartersComplianceRegistry.rehabilitate() tx hash on Base L2.

cooldownPeriodEnds.description: Same-reason re-attestation is blocked until this datetime (90 days post-rehabilitation per ADR-2605192230 Open Question 3).
